questions.question:
다음 대화에서 A의 심경 변화로 가장 적절한 것은?

A: I hear you're going on a trip to Jeju-do tomorrow. Have a great time!
B: Thanks, but I don't think I can. I don't feel well.
A: Oh, no. What's wrong?
B: I have a terrible cold.
A: I'm so sorry. I just hope you feel better soon.
questions.explanation: A는 처음에 B의 여행을 축하해주며 cheerful한 감정을 보이다가, B가 감기에 걸렸다는 것을 알게 되면서 worried로 변한다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 부분 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것들로 짝지어진 것은?

A: You look a little ⓐ worried, Somi.
B: Well, I just joined the NGO VANK. Remember? You once talked about it in class.
A: Of course, I do. Its main goal is to ⓑ criticize Korea to the world.
B: You know, I'm interested in Korean history and culture.
A: Then, it's the ⓒ perfect choice for you. So, what are you worried about?
B: Well, it's just ... my English is not good enough.
A: Oh, don't worry, Somi. Your English is OK. You'll do fine.
B: Do you really think so?
A: Sure. I just hope you have a chance to ⓓ forget more about Korean history.
B: Thanks, Mr. Hopkins. I'll do my ⓔ best.
questions.explanation: ⓑ criticize는 '비판하다'의 의미로, VANK의 목표는 '한국을 알리다(promote)'이므로 부적절하다. ⓓ forget은 '잊다'의 의미인데, 문맥상 '더 배우다(learn)'가 적절하다.

options: The geographical characteristics of Jeju-do that attract dolphins
The necessity of prohibiting all types of aquariums in the world
The importance of youth engagement in social and environmental causes
The detailed biological differences between endangered and common dolphins
The history of non-governmental organizations in South Korea
questions.question:
[지문]
You can work with NGOs as a teenager. It is a great way to learn about social issues and make the world better. Are you interested? Then, read Inho's blog below.

JAN 5
I grew up in Jeju-do, so I had many chances to see dolphins. Then, I learned that many dolphins are in danger. Some are even endangered. I thought I should do something.

So, I searched the Internet and found an NGO, Dolphin Lovers. It does various activities such as cleaning up beaches and helping dolphins. After some thought, I joined it today.

[지문]
다음 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 글에서 십대 청소년이 사회적·환경적 문제(돌고래 보호)에 참여하기 위해 NGO에 가입하는 과정을 보여줌으로써, 청소년의 사회 참여의 중요성을 강조하고 있다.

questions.question:
[지문]
This afternoon, I took part in a training class for Halla and Olle, two dolphins in an aquarium in Jeju-do. ⓐThe latest project of Dolphin Lovers is to return them to the sea. For this, Halla and Olle first need to learn some skills. They will need them to survive in the wild. ⓑI really wanted to be part of the project. Luckily, I got the chance. I just ran some errands in the training class today, but the experience made me so excited.

ⓒToday, Halla and Olle went back to the sea. There was a small ceremony, and all the members of Dolphin Lovers were there. The ceremony made us quite emotional. ⓓIn fact, I cried a little. Now I cannot see Halla and Olle anymore! However, I was very happy at the same time. ⓔAfter 10 years of hard life in an aquarium, now all the sea is no longer their home. "Live freely and happily ever after!" I shouted and waved goodbye to them.

[지문]
주어진 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중 글의 흐름에 가장 관계 없는 것은?
questions.explanation: ⓔ 'After 10 years of hard life in an aquarium, now all the sea is no longer their home.'는 문맥상 모순이다. 돌고래가 바다로 돌아갔으므로 '바다가 더 이상 그들의 집이 아니다'는 표현은 맞지 않으며, '바다가 그들의 진정한 집이 되었다'는 의미여야 한다.

options: Chris's experiences at his previous school.
Ms. Lee explaining the history of the school.
Ms. Lee checking the attendance of the students
Ms. Lee's simple advice on how to make new friends.
After-school activities for students to join this year.
questions.question:
[지문]
A: Today is the first day of school. How's it going, Chris?
B: Good, but I'm a little nervous.
A: You'll be all right. I hope you make lots of friends soon.
B: I hope so, too. Thank you, Ms. Lee.

[지문]
다음 글 다음에 이어질 내용으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 대화에서 Ms. Lee가 Chris에게 '곧 많은 친구를 사귀기를 바란다'고 말했으므로, 다음에는 새로운 친구를 사귀기 위한 방법에 대한 조언이 이어지는 것이 자연스럽다.

options: Comparison and Contrast: Comparing two different dolphin species found in Jeju-do
Problem and Solution: Identifying the threat to dolphins and taking action to join an organization
Cause and Effect: Explaining how internet usage leads to environmental pollution
Timeline Listing: Listing the history of the dolphin protection organization
Definition and Example: Defining what an NGO is and listing various types of NGOs
questions.question:
[지문]
JAN 5

다음 글의 전개 방식으로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 글은 돌고래의 멸종 위기라는 문제를 제시한 후, 이 문제를 해결하기 위해 NGO 단체에 가입하는 방법을 제시하는 문제-해결 구조로 전개된다.

options: To warn him that the test will be very difficult.
To agree with him that he needs more practice.
To judge his math ability based on his grades.
To relieve his anxiety and give him confidence.
To predict that he will get a perfect score.
questions.question:
[지문]
A: I have a math test tomorrow.
B: Good luck, Minsu. I hope you do well on it.
A: Thanks, but I'm a little nervous. I don't think I'm well prepared.
B: Don't worry. You'll do fine.

[지문]
다음 글의 밑줄 친 "You'll do fine."의 의도로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: A가 불안감을 표현했을 때, B가 'Don't worry. You'll do fine.'이라고 말하는 것은 A의 불안감을 덜어주고 자신감을 주기 위한 의도이다.

options: Stay safe and healthy in the wild!
Live freely and happily ever after!
Come back to the aquarium anytime!
Beware of the fishing nets and plastics!
Have a safe journey to your new home!

다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: 돌고래를 바다로 돌려보내며 안녕을 고하는 상황이므로 '언제든 수족관에 돌아와'라는 표현은 문맥상 적절하지 않다. 다른 선택지들은 모두 돌고래의 안전과 행복을 바라는 내용으로 적절하다.

questions.question:
다음 중 밑줄 친 부분의 쓰임이 다른 하나를 고르시오.

① The teacher made the students curious about the new topic.
② The movie made the audience silent during the final scene.
③ His encouraging words made the team confident before the match.
④ The noisy machine made the room uncomfortable for everyone.
⑤ The company made a new service for the workers.
questions.explanation: ①~④는 'make + 목적어 + 형용사' 구조로 '~을 ~하게 만들다'는 의미이다. 반면 ⑤의 'make a new service'는 '새로운 서비스를 만들다'는 뜻으로, 'make + 목적어 + 명사' 구조로 쓰임이 다르다.

questions.question:
[지문]
You can work with NGOs as a teenager. It is a great way (A) [to learn / learning] about social issues and make the world better. Are you (B) [interesting / interested]? Then, (C) [read / reading] Inho's blog below.

[지문]
다음 글의 괄호 (A), (B), (C)에서 어법상 적절한 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: (A) 'way to learn'은 '배우는 방법'으로 to부정사가 맞다. (B) 'be interested in'은 '~에 관심이 있다'는 의미로 interested가 맞다. (C) 명령문이므로 동사원형 'read'가 맞다.

questions.question:
[지문]
A: Hello, teens! Do you want to make the world better? Then, join Green Teens! Our goal is to stop global warming. For this, we do various activities. (A) 예를 들어, 우리는 제로 웨이스트 챌린지와 나무 심기 행사를 엽니다. Interested? Then, join us! I hope we can make a difference together.

<조건>
- 아래 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성할 것 (어형 변화 없음)
- and / hold / we / example, / zero-waste / events / challenges / For / planting / tree

[지문]
A: Hello, teens! Do you want to make the world better? Then, join Green Teens! Our goal is to stop global warming. For this, we do various activities. (A) 예를 들어, 우리는 제로 웨이스트 챌린지와 나무 심기 행사를 엽니다. Interested? Then, join us! I hope we can make a difference together.

위 우리말 (A)와 일치하도록 <조건>에 맞춰 영작했을 때, 5번째에 올 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?
questions.explanation: 주어진 단어를 배열하면 'For example, we hold zero-waste challenges and tree planting events'가 되며, 5번째 단어는 'zero-waste'이다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ에 대한 아래 <보기>의 설명에서 적절한 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?

Today, Halla and Olle went back to the sea. ⓐ There was a small ceremony, and all the members of Dolphin Lovers were there. ⓑThe ceremony made us quite emotional. In fact, I cried a little. Now ⓒI cannot see Halla and Olle anymore! However, I was very happy at the same time. ⓓ After 10 years of hard life in an aquarium, now all the sea is their home. "Live freely and happily ever after!" ⓔI shouted and waved goodbye to them.

<보기>
㉠ all과 the가 사용될때는 the + all의 어순이므로 틀린 문장이다.
㉡ made는 뒤에 목적어 us와 목적보어 emotional이 오는 사역동사 + 목적어 + 형용사 구조가 문법적으로 적절하다.
㉢ anymore는 부정문에서 '더 이상'이라는 의미로 쓰이는 부사이며, cannot과 함께 쓰여 의미상 자연스럽다.
㉣ all the sea는 '바다 전체'라는 복수 개념을 나타내므로 뒤에 오는 동사는 단수 동사 is가 아니라 are로 고쳐야 한다.
㉤ shouted and waved는 and가 두 동작을 병렬로 연결하는 등위접속사이므로 두 동사 모두 과거형을 쓰는 것이 맞다. 또한 작별 인사를 보낸 대상을 나타낼 때는 to를 삭제해야 한다.
questions.explanation: ㉡과 ㉢이 적절한 설명이다. ㉡은 'make + 목적어 + 형용사'는 사역동사의 올바른 구조이다. ㉢은 anymore가 부정문에서 '더 이상'의 의미로 쓰이며 cannot과의 조합이 자연스럽다.

questions.question:
어법상 옳지 않은 것을 모두 고르시오.

① Jina woke up early to catch the first bus.
② She didn't went to the concert yesterday.
③ Minho added a little water to the mixture.
④ He hopes he can make the right decision for his team.
⑤ The loud noise made the children to feel uncomfortable.
questions.explanation: ②번: 'didn't went'는 틀렸다. 과거시제에서는 'didn't go'로 써야 한다. ⑤번: 'make + 목적어 + 동사원형' 구조인데 'to feel'로 to부정사를 썼으므로 'to'를 삭제해야 한다. 올바른 형태는 'The loud noise made the children feel uncomfortable.'이다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 내용을 한 문장으로 요약하고자 한다. 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

JAN 5

Realizing the dolphins' ___(A)___ situation, the writer joined an NGO and participated in environmental ___(B)___ activities to help them.
questions.explanation: 글에서 돌고래들이 위험한(dangerous) 상황에 처해있다고 언급하고 있으며, 이를 해결하기 위해 해변 정화 같은 환경 보호(protection) 활동에 참여했다고 설명하고 있다.

questions.question:
밑줄 친 단어를 문맥상 아래의 단어로 바꿔 쓴다고 할 때, 적절하지 않은 것은?

options: How long had Halla and Olle been kept in aquarium?
What specific survival skills were taught to the dolphins?
What role did the writer play during the dolphin training?
How did the writer feel when watching the release of the dolphins?
What is the objective of the latest project by Dolphin Lovers?
questions.question:
다음 글을 바탕으로 인터뷰를 진행한다고 할 때, 글의 내용만으로는 답변을 들을 수 없는 질문은?

options: Because they were injured and needed physical therapy.
Because they had lost their natural instincts during their life in captivity.
Because the NGO wanted to show their training process to the public.
Because they needed to learn how to avoid plastic waste specifically.
Because the aquarium laws require training before any animal transfer.
questions.question:
다음 글의 내용으로 미루어 볼 때, Halla와 Olle가 방류 전 훈련을 받아야 했던 가장 근본적인 이유는?

questions.question:
다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것을 <보기>에서 있는 대로 고른 것은?

I grew up in Jeju-do, so I had many chances to see dolphins. Then, I learned that many dolphins are in danger. Some are even endangered. I thought I should do something.

So, I searched the Internet and found an NGO, Dolphin Lovers. It does various activities such as cleaning up beaches and helping dolphins. After some thought, I joined it today.

<보기>
a. Inho created the NGO 'Dolphin Lovers' himself to protect marine animals.
b. Aunt Sumi and Inho planned to meet at the beach cleanup party beforehand.
c. Halla and Olle had lived in the aquarium for a decade before being released.
d. The writer played a major role in training the dolphins by teaching them essential skills.
e. The writer felt mixed emotions—sadness and happiness—during the release ceremony.
questions.explanation: a: 글에서 인호가 'Dolphin Lovers'를 창립했다는 언급이 없다. b: 글에서 아주머니와 미리 만나기로 계획했다는 언급이 없다. c: 맞다. d: 글에서 저자가 심부름만 했다고 했으므로 주요 역할을 하지 않았다. e: 맞다. 따라서 a, b, d가 틀렸다.

questions.question:
다음 글의 밑줄 친 ⓐ~ⓔ 중, 흐름상 어색한 것을 모두 고르면?

You can work with NGOs as a teenager. It is a ⓐ great way to ⓑ ignore social issues and make the world ⓒ worse. Are you ⓓ interested? Then, ⓔ read Inho's blog below.
questions.explanation: ⓑ 'ignore(무시하다)'와 ⓒ 'worse(더 악화된)'가 문맥상 어색하다. NGO와 함께 일하는 것은 사회 문제를 무시하는 것이 아니라 해결하는 것이고, 세상을 더 악화시키는 것이 아니라 개선하는 것이어야 한다. 따라서 ⓑ와 ⓒ가 흐름상 어색하다.

questions.question:
[지문]
Many dolphins get sick or even die because of plastic waste and fishing nets, so (a) cleaning up beaches is considered a crucial preventive measure for marine life safety. There was a beach cleanup party today, and I took part in it. Cleaning up the beach was not easy, but I enjoyed it. Oh, I saw Aunt Sumi there. (b) She was present at the scene because she is also affiliated with the same organization, Dolphin Lovers. What a small world!

This afternoon, I took part in a training class for Halla and Olle, two dolphins in an aquarium in Jeju-do.

The latest project of Dolphin Lovers is to return them to the sea. For this, (c) Halla and Olle are required to acquire adaptive skills necessary for their survival in the open ocean. They will need them to survive in the wild. I really wanted to be part of the project. Luckily, I got the chance. (d) My primary responsibility in today's class was to instruct the dolphins directly on how to hunt for food. I just ran some errands in the training class today, but the experience made me so excited.

다음 글의 흐름상, 밑줄 친 문장 (a)~(d) 중 인과관계나 전체 맥락과 다르거나 논리적으로 어색한 진술은?
questions.explanation: 문장 (d)는 '오늘 수업에서 나의 주요 책임은 돌고래들에게 먹이를 사냥하는 방법을 직접 지도하는 것이었다'고 서술하고 있습니다. 그러나 바로 다음 문장에서 '나는 오늘 훈련 수업에서 심부름을 할 뿐이었지만, 그 경험이 나를 매우 흥분시켰다'고 말하고 있습니다. 이는 명백한 모순입니다. 주요 책임(primary responsibility)이 있었다고 하면서 동시에 심부름(errands)만 했다는 것은 논리적으로 어색합니다. 따라서 정답은 ④번입니다.
